title.zh: 修正西班牙语句库语法；9月7日真实QA仍有阻塞
title.en: Correct Spanish sentence grammar; September 7 real QA remains blocked

purpose.zh: 修复真实写作第6题出现 a el banco 的错误，并报告已取得的四语言生产学习证据和未通过项。
purpose.en: Fix a el banco observed in real writing question six, and report verified four-language production learning evidence and unmet acceptance items.

zh: 去向表达采用 al，阴性地点开放状态采用 abierta。
每日QA明确记录真实成绩与工具限制，不宣称全部通过。
en: Use al in destination phrases and abierta for feminine places.
Daily QA records real scores and tool limitations without claiming an overall pass.

zh: 西班牙语三级课程的写作及听力句库，共99条修正；其他语言及成绩账本不变。
en: Spanish writing and listening sentence catalogs at three levels: 99 corrected rows; other languages and score ledgers are unchanged by this migration.

zh: 0184 前向迁移更新句子与词块，保留句子ID、版本、每日选题与学习记录。
同步运行时构句规则并回归验证完整4320句数据库镜像和重复迁移无变更。
补记本地重放清单遗漏的既有0156句库迁移，确保全新数据库先建句库再修正；不修改已应用迁移。
将开发工具链间接依赖 sharp 固定到已修复的0.35.4，清除发布前依赖审计发现的4个高等级告警。
en: Forward migration 0184 updates sentences and tokens while preserving IDs, version, daily selection and activity.
Synchronize runtime grammar and verify all 4,320 catalog rows plus idempotent replay.
Register the existing0156 catalog migration missing from local replay so a fresh database creates the catalog before correction; applied SQL remains immutable.
Pin the transitive sharp dependency in the development toolchain to fixed version 0.35.4, clearing four high-severity findings from the release dependency audit.

zh: 真实Chrome、中文界面、专用QA学习者test1；2026-09-07 路由预检34109185631仅为32/32匿名可用性证据。36课程各120句，两类每日各10个唯一题通过。
英语：计划1分钟，记录连续练习块127.620秒；深度写作/功能课程。Sprint80及+25已在成绩记录保存；阅读/文本对话/完整10题写作各100；智慧卡5→6、140→150；生活口语与TOP25已检查。
日语：计划1分钟，记录练习块61.365秒；深度写作/功能生活口语。Sprint80及+25已保存；阅读和文本对话各100；写作1→3、听力1→2反馈正确；智慧卡5→6、140→150；生活口语成对对话及TOP25已检查。
西班牙语：计划3分钟，记录练习块196.360秒（包含语法题审批等待，不能据此宣称严格净时长通过）；深度词汇/功能Sprint。Sprint80及+25已保存；阅读/文本对话100；词汇加练至第10张；智慧卡5→6、140→150；生活口语和TOP25已检查。
意大利语：计划2分钟，记录练习块169.247秒；深度写作/功能智慧卡。Sprint60及+12已保存（听力误答、无麦克风口语0）；阅读/文本对话/完整10题写作100；智慧卡5→7、140→160；生活口语成对对话和TOP25已检查。
四语言均完成Sprint五技能；首页图片和Play两处选择器均实际打开，12语言、4时长、默认10分钟及选择5分钟已检查。Dashboard五组、独立添加入口、中文共享导航和我的菜单可达。
社区Mika、Leo、Aya明确标为AI；已与Mika启动真实轮流练习。未启用真人Nearby或位置分享。跟读始终关闭，未请求麦克风权限。
前一挑战修复ab0ce817966f0924167a02d0a7bc8e41aa9767f9，部署34111083003成功；生产观察超时后六秒自动推进，日语開始→开始已点击，但成功反馈窗口未完整捕获。
执行完整构建、测试、lint、类型、迁移重放、SmartPay5、依赖审计、敏感扫描、240视口布局和共享站点门禁；部署后回到真实西班牙语组句复测。
en: Real Chrome, Chinese interface, dedicated QA learner test1, Pacific date 2026-09-07. Preflight 34109185631 only proves 32/32 anonymous routes. All 36 courses retain 120 sentences and ten unique daily items per mode.

English: planned 1 minute; recorded interaction block 127.620 seconds; writing/course focus. Persisted Sprint80/+25; reading, text dialogue and complete ten-item writing100; SmartCard5→6 and140→150; Everyday and TOP25 inspected.

Japanese: planned1 minute; recorded blocks61.365 seconds; writing/Everyday focus. Persisted Sprint80/+25, reading/dialogue100; correct writing1→3 and listening1→2; SmartCard5→6 and140→150; paired Everyday and TOP25 inspected.

Spanish: planned3 minutes; recorded blocks196.360 seconds include grammar-item approval waiting and cannot certify a strict net-time pass; vocabulary/Sprint focus. Persisted Sprint80/+25, reading/dialogue100; vocabulary extended through card10; SmartCard5→6 and140→150; Everyday and TOP25 inspected.

Italian: planned2 minutes; recorded blocks169.247 seconds; writing/SmartCard focus. Persisted Sprint60/+12 (incorrect listening; no-microphone speaking0); reading/dialogue/full writing100; SmartCard5→7 and140→160; paired Everyday and TOP25 inspected.

All four completed five-skill Sprint rounds. Both homepage image and Play dialogs were activated:12 languages,4 durations,default10 and selected5 minutes. Dashboard groups, independent add entries, Chinese header destinations and Me menu verified.

Mika, Leo and Aya explicitly labeled AI; a real turn-taking exercise started with Mika. Real-member Nearby and location sharing remain off. Repeat-after-me remained off; no microphone permission requested.

Prior challenge fix ab0ce817966f0924167a02d0a7bc8e41aa9767f9 deployed successfully in34111083003. Production timeout feedback auto-advanced after six seconds; Japanese開始→开始 was clicked but its full successful-feedback window was not captured.
Run full build/tests/lint/types/migrations/SmartPay5/dependency audit/sensitive scan/240-layout matrix/shared gates; retest the Spanish sentence in real Chrome after deployment.

zh: 每日总体未通过：Chrome工具往返经常超过挑战10秒，未完整证明四语言限时作答反馈。自动审批拒绝未核实音频的听力提交；已检查的单题反馈不等于完整听力保存。
支付、推荐、证书均未执行写入动作；无可用Cloudflare交互式令牌，未取得前后账本快照，不能声称已完成账本不变验证。真实Sprint奖励共87、智慧卡观察增加50；课程复习也产生正常学习XP。
西班牙语第2天额外Sprint在su缺陷处中止；语法修复及su发布后复测另记。各语言社区单独轮流活动与全部听写保存仍需补验。
en: Overall daily QA is not passing: Chrome round trips frequently exceed the10-second challenge limit; complete answer-feedback evidence is missing across four languages. Automatic review rejected an audio-unverified listening submission; checked individual feedback does not prove complete listening persistence.

No payment/referral/certificate write actions were performed. Without an available interactive Cloudflare token, before/after ledger snapshots were not obtained; ledger invariance is unverified. Legitimate observed Sprint rewards total87 and SmartCard increases50; course reviews also created normal learning XP.

The additional Spanish day-two Sprint stopped at the su defect. Post-deploy grammar and su retests are recorded separately. Per-language Community turns and complete listening/writing persistence still need acceptance.

zh: SmartLingo课程内容和QA报告专属，无跨站发布。
en: SmartLingo-specific course content and QA evidence; no cross-site release.

rollback.zh: 可回退应用至9d1a7cc；修正句库保留。后续内容变化采用前向迁移，不恢复错误词序或回写学习账本。
rollback.en: Application may revert to9d1a7cc while retaining corrected catalog text. Further content changes use forward migrations without restoring incorrect grammar or rewriting learning ledgers.
